## ms-q2.tex (steps=8, msquestion=7)

**Question summary:** (a) Find \(T_n\) for four sequences. (b) Temperature differences: City Q is \(+6\), R is \(-4\), S is \(-9\) relative to City P.

**Current MS (8 marks):** (a)(i)-(iv) each `{1A}` (4); (b)(i) `{1M+1A}` (2); (b)(ii) `{1M+1A}` (2).

**Verified answers (all correct):**
- (a)(i) \(T_n = 2 \times 3^{n-1}\)
- (a)(ii) \(T_n = 8n - 20\)
- (a)(iii) \(T_n = 125 \times \left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^{n-1}\) (or \(5^{3-n}\))
- (a)(iv) \(T_n = \dfrac{n-3}{2n-1}\)
- (b)(i) Q = \(24^\circ\text{C}\), R = \(14^\circ\text{C}\)
- (b)(ii) P = \(15^\circ\text{C}\), Q = \(21^\circ\text{C}\)

**Recommended fix:** Reduce (b)(ii) by 1 mark. After (b)(i) uses full method marks, (b)(ii) mainly applies the same idea in reverse; award answer only.

```latex
\msstep{(ii) \ \text{City } P = 11 + 4 = 15^\circ\text{C}, \ \text{City } Q = 15 + 6 = 21^\circ\text{C}}{1A}
```

**New total:** 4 + 2 + 1 = **7**

---

## ms-q3.tex (steps=7, msquestion=5)

**Question summary:** (a) Simplify \(4(2p-3)-2[p-3(2-q)]+5\). (b) Trapezium with height 4 cm, bases \(x\) and \(3x\); find \(A\) in terms of \(x\), then when \(x=5\).

**Current MS (7 marks):** (a) `{1M}` + `{1M}` + `{1A}` (3); (b)(i) `{1M+1A}` (2); (b)(ii) `{1M+1A}` (2).

**Verified answers (all correct):**
- (a) \(6p - 6q + 5\)
- (b)(i) \(A = 8x\)
- (b)(ii) \(A = 40\)

**Recommended fix:** Collapse (a) to one method step + one answer; make (b)(ii) answer-only (substitution after (b)(i)).

Replace the `(a)` block with:
```latex
\begin{mspart}{(a)}
  \msstep{= 8p - 12 - 2(p - 6 + 3q) + 5}{1M}
  \msstep{= 6p - 6q + 5}{1A}
\end{mspart}
```

Change (b)(ii) to:
```latex
\msstep{(ii) \ A = 40}{1A}
```

**New total:** 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = **5**

---

## ms-q6.tex (steps=5, msquestion=8)

**Question summary:** (a) H.C.F. of 18, 24, 48 by short division. (b) Buses every 12, 18, 30 min; how many simultaneous arrivals in the next 360 min after one just occurred?

**Current MS (5 marks):** (a) `{1M+1A}` (2); (b) `{1M}` + `{1M}` + `{1A}` (3).

**Verified answers (all correct):**
- (a) H.C.F. = 6
- (b) L.C.M.(12, 18, 30) = 180; number of times = \(360 \div 180 = 2\)

**Recommended fix:** Expand (a) to show short-division working; upgrade (b) to `{1M+1A}` per sub-step; remove the redundant final `{1A}` on bare `2`.

```latex
\begin{mspart}{(a)}
  \msstep{$18,\ 24,\ 48$ by short division (or prime factorisation)}{2M}
  \msstep{\text{H.C.F.} = 6}{1M+1A}
\end{mspart}

\begin{mspart}{(b)}
  \msstep{\text{L.C.M.}(12, 18, 30) = 180}{1M+1A}
  \msstep{\text{Number of times} = \dfrac{360}{180} = 2}{1M+1A}
\end{mspart}
```

**New total:** 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = **8**

---

## ms-q7.tex (steps=6, msquestion=8)

**Question summary:** Cut a \(120 \times 84\) cm rectangle into identical squares with no waste. (a) Greatest square side. (b)(i) Squares along length and width. (b)(ii) Total squares.

**Current MS (6 marks):** (a) `{1M+1A}` (2); (b)(i) combined length+width `{1M+1A}` (2); (b)(ii) `{1M+1A}` (2).

**Verified answers (all correct):**
- (a) H.C.F.(120, 84) = 12 cm
- (b)(i) Length: 10; width: 7
- (b)(ii) Total = 70

**Recommended fix:** Split (b)(i) into separate length and width steps (+2 marks).

```latex
\begin{mspart}{(b)}
  \msstep{(i) \ \text{Along the length: } \dfrac{120}{12} = 10}{1M+1A}
  \msstep{\text{Along the width: } \dfrac{84}{12} = 7}{1M+1A}
  \msstep{(ii) \ \text{Total number of squares} = 10 \times 7 = 70}{1M+1A}
\end{mspart}
```

**New total:** 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = **8**

---

## ms-q9.tex (steps=7, msquestion=8)

**Question summary:** \(T_n = 8n + 1\). (a)(i) First 4 terms. (a)(ii) \(T_1 + \cdots + T_{10}\). (b)(i) Is 7th term prime? (b)(ii) Is 10th term prime?

**Current MS (7 marks):** (a)(i) `{1A}` (1); (a)(ii) `{1M}` + `{1A}` (2); (b)(i) `{1M+1A}` (2); (b)(ii) `{1M+1A}` (2).

**Verified answers (all correct):**
- (a)(i) 9, 17, 25, 33
- (a)(ii) 450
- (b)(i) \(T_7 = 57 = 3 \times 19\), not prime
- (b)(ii) \(T_{10} = 81 = 9 \times 9\), not prime

**Recommended fix:** Increase (a)(i) to `{2A}` (four terms listed; matches pattern in test 6 ms-q9).

```latex
\msstep{(i) \ 9,\ 17,\ 25,\ 33}{2A}
```

**New total:** 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = **8**

---
